short: Commanded by Günther Prien, U-47 was a German Type VIIB submarine famous for infiltrating Scapa Flow in 1939.
full:
Commissioned in 1938, U-47 was one of the most successful U-boats of the Kriegsmarine during the early years of World War II. In October 1939, it achieved widespread notoriety by penetrating the heavily defended British Home Fleet anchorage at Scapa Flow. It sank the battleship HMS Royal Oak, a devastating propaganda victory for Germany and a severe shock to the Royal Navy.

During its operational career, U-47 sank over 30 merchant vessels, contributing significantly to the Axis tonnage war in the Atlantic. In March 1941, the submarine disappeared with all hands while on patrol south of Iceland, likely destroyed by depth charges from the British destroyer HMS Wolverine, though the exact cause remains contested.
